mechanism: Chlorpromazine may potentiate the hypotensive effects of telmisartan through additive vasodilation and reduced sympathetic tone, while telmisartan may increase chlorpromazine levels via CYP2D6 inhibition.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely; consider dosage adjustment of telmisartan or chlorpromazine if hypotension occurs; educate patient on orthostatic precautions.
